nodes.label: CameraObj Native-Frame Remap Is Orientation-Only
nodes.rationale: Applying the native pre-override KEX camera frame to visible-weapon orientation fixed HMD yaw/roll bleed, but applying it to translation broke apparent scale/depth (clipping, undersized meshes). Translation stays on the older HMD-compensated path until a dedicated probe proves a better frame.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.22 Proxy Uses Screen-Up Look-At as Diagnostic Default
nodes.rationale: v0.21 proved plain (roll,pitch,yaw) turned pitched aim into roll and mirrored the horizon, so v0.22 aims from the proxy's world position and derives Roll from camera/screen up. This is the first diagnostic default to give the proxy an explicit roll reference.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.23 Treats Screen-Up Proxy Roll Sign as Unproven
nodes.rationale: v0.22 loaded and ran but the user still saw roll while aimed up/down, so v0.23 flips weapon_proxy_roll_sign to -1.0 as a small diagnostic rather than reverting to native CameraObj scalar variants. Proxy pose logging (rollRaw/rollApplied/rollSign) is added to make the sign question falsifiable.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.24 Tests Proxy-Origin Look-At With Zero Dynamic Roll
nodes.rationale: Sign-flipping a large dynamic Roll term was recognized as another scalar workaround, so v0.24 adds facing_mode=5: proxy-origin look-at with no per-frame Roll solve at all, isolating whether dynamic Roll itself is the problem.

nodes.label: Snap-Turn v2 Uses Accumulator/Body Transport Plus Immediate Display Yaw Step
nodes.rationale: Earlier snap/direct-yaw paths caused wrong-way turns, flash frames, and pitch perturbation, so v2 reuses KEX's normal mouse-accumulator transport and updates the cached display baseline immediately by a yaw-only expected delta instead of waiting on a delayed RenderView sync. Short post-snap HMD deltas are suppressed for 180ms so head motion isn't stacked into the snap.

nodes.label: Gate Route-B Menu Pointer on Native Menu Draw Frames
nodes.rationale: Route-B's cursor-warp fired during gameplay/weapon tests because RmlUi menus aren't represented by gameUiActive_, so the fix gates OS-cursor warp/click on the D3D frame classifier reporting menuDraws>0 rather than adding a new RmlUi hook.

nodes.label: Snap Turns Get a Compositor Black-Frame Comfort Layer
nodes.rationale: A dedicated final OpenXR quad layer renders black for snap_turn_blackout_ms after snap v2 commits, kept separate from vr_effects and the scene copy so it doesn't disturb other tests. It is reversible via config and avoids clearing/corrupting the underlying game frame while hiding a remaining one-frame visual discontinuity.

nodes.label: Pistol Muzzle Flash Follows via Flash-Object CameraObj, Not Projectile Retuning
nodes.rationale: AE source shows NDViewmodelBase.SpawnMuzzleFlash() creates a separate flash object with its own CameraObj, so the fix attaches an SS2VR script to the flash archetype and writes its CameraObj from controller pose. The already-confirmed deferred projectile redirect and aim signs are left untouched to avoid mixing visual polish with functional shot direction.

nodes.label: First Real Game-Event FX Binding Uses Squirrel HitPoints Polling
nodes.rationale: A Squirrel-side player HitPoints watcher routes through the already-proven ss2vr_fx config-setter bridge, avoiding a new reverse-engineered damage RVA or a second visual-effects path. The same ss2vr_fx event path is intended to later carry comms/poison triggers too.

nodes.label: Keep Active Docs Lean; Archive Settled and Sidequest Trails
nodes.rationale: CURRENT_STATE.md and HYPOTHESES.md had started acting like chat history, making future agents reread stale or disproven work as current; settled foundations and sidequest trails move to their _ARCHIVE.md counterparts. The Excel tracker is synced from PROJECT_PHASES.md using a weighted status model (YES=100%, BUILT=75%, EXPLORING=35%, NO=0%).

nodes.label: Right-Arm Ammo HUD Should Be a Separate Cropped Quad, Not the Old Hand-Panel Slot
nodes.rationale: A default-off right_arm_hud_* path submits a second cropped OpenXR quad near the right controller using a hardcoded percentage screenshot slice as a fast scaffold, explicitly marked temporary until native overlay-rect crops replace it.

nodes.label: Right-Arm Ammo HUD Should Use Native Overlay Rects by Default
nodes.rationale: User testing proved the percentage slice unstable because inventory mode expands that HUD region and pulls in unrelated data, so the crop source defaults to native_rect, cropping the engine's own ammo overlay rect guarded by the known gOverlayOrder signature. The slice path is preserved only as a diagnostic fallback.

nodes.label: Expand Phase 5.8.1 Digital Glitch Modes Through the Existing GPU Effect Manager
nodes.rationale: datamosh, mosaic/deres, and depthglitch are added to the already-confirmed D3D11 post-process path with the same ss2vr_fx trigger surface; datamosh uses per-eye-local frame history to avoid cross-eye smear discomfort. Wiring a true shader-readable scene-depth SRV is deliberately deferred to a separate 5.8.2 task rather than bundled in.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.25 Tests Captured Screen-Up Basis Before Roll-to-Offset Remap
nodes.rationale: v0.24 proved removing explicit Roll alone doesn't remove visible roll, so facing_mode=6 captures a flat-screen right/up basis from Camera.GetFacing() at mode entry and solves proxy-origin look-at against it, deferring roll-to-offset remapping which resembled the old slidey-weapon failure mode.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.26 Hard-Kills Proxy Roll Before Quaternion/Model-Axis Work
nodes.rationale: v0.25's captured Camera.GetFacing() baseline generated huge rollApplied values near pitched views, so v0.26 forces world-object Roll to 0.0 every frame to cleanly fork the diagnosis: if visible roll stops, tune static offsets; if it persists, the roll is downstream of FlatAim's explicit Roll channel.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.27 Treats Visible Roll as Downstream of Explicit Roll
nodes.rationale: v0.26 logs proved facing.x=0.00/rollApplied=0.00/rollKill=1 while the user still saw roll, ruling out a nonzero Roll scalar as the cause. v0.27 stops tuning Roll signs and instead adds a proxy-only heading mirror plus intended-basis (basisF/basisR/basisU) diagnostics to compare intended basis against rendered mesh behavior.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.28 Adopts Dark Matrix Heading Convention for Proxy Facing
nodes.rationale: Dark source's mx_mat2rad reads heading as atan2(forward.y, forward.x) while FlatAim's proxy used atan2(dir.x, dir.y) -- a swapped convention that better explains 'horizon works, pitch grows into roll' than more sign tuning. facing_mode=8 builds an upright basis and extracts Dark (bank,pitch,heading) from it directly.

nodes.label: Detect Radiation/Toxin Through Squirrel Properties and Draw a VR Hazard Meter
nodes.rationale: Native RadLevel/RadAmb/Toxin properties are polled read-only from Squirrel and published through the existing config-setter bridge as ss2vr_hazard, driving a small OpenXR RAD/TOX meter and reusing the GPU effect manager for pulses (depthglitch, aberration) without hooking native hazard code or the flat HUD.

nodes.label: v1.42 Restores Inventory Visibility and Makes Controller Fallback Explicit
nodes.rationale: User testing showed the right-arm HUD spike blanked inventory, left-stick movement wasn't moving the player, controller-held weapons were still HMD-tugged, and gravity-glove objects used the wrong rotation basis; the fix forces the full UI quad on during UI/cursor mode, allows keyboard movement fallback until KEX-native held-axis is proven, defaults weapon HMD compensation off, and defaults gravity-glove facing to Dark/AE (bank,pitch,heading).

nodes.label: Current Test Run Uses Quiet Logs With Only Active Diagnostics Enabled
nodes.rationale: The prior test set was blocked by inventory disappearance, left-stick failure, and HMD/viewmodel bleed, and logging everything at once made logs harder to interpret; solved/background probes are turned off in the live INI, keeping only native_movement_log and model_pose_diagnostic on so the next headset pass stays falsifiable.

nodes.label: FlatAim Proves View-Frame Aim and Native-Velocity Projectile Anchoring
nodes.rationale: Free-aim offsets are treated as view-frame tangent offsets (normalize(forward + tan(dx)*right + tan(dy)*up)) rather than added directly to world heading/pitch, which had pinched near pitch poles and turned horizontal aim into roll. Deferred native projectile velocity is preserved as the true forward basis and the view-frame offset is applied around it, with both facing and velocity written for coherent gameplay state.

nodes.label: Right-Hand Projectile Aim Defaults On Through Squirrel
nodes.rationale: With the Squirrel deferred projectile redirect repeatedly confirmed as the working shot carrier, SS2VRWeaponAimEnabled() now treats a missing ss2vr_weapon_aim as 1, while the old DLL trace/launch rewrite path stays disabled as a dead-end.

nodes.label: FlatAim Broad-Weapon Fixes Stay Domain-Specific
nodes.rationale: With pistol aim/projectiles/muzzle flash working, later weapon symptoms are fixed in their own domain rather than reusing the pistol's fix: laser sideways bolts via projectile object-facing mode, long-gun butt intrusion via proxy pivot, and Wrench treated as a likely melee-viewmodel-path issue until logs prove otherwise.

nodes.label: FlatAim Rendered-Object Frame Beats Stored/View Basis for World Attachments
nodes.rationale: World-space proxy pivot and effect placement must use the rendered object frame from SS2FA_FacingBasis(facing); stored proxyBasis/view-frame bases are for solving aim only, not for placing world attachments. The laser bolt and shotgun pivot bugs shared this root: new features had been consuming reflected view/native-launch bases as if they were rendered object bases.

nodes.label: FlatAim Wrench/Melee Follows the Melee Viewmodel Route
nodes.rationale: Melee is implemented by patching NDShockMeleeViewmodel rather than extending the gun ModelName proxy route, letting the native melee update run first and then writing PlyrArm from the solved FlatAim view-frame aim, since true hand-bone IK is outside Squirrel's capability.

nodes.label: FlatAim Wrench/PlyrArm Uses Native-Relative Crossed Orientation
nodes.rationale: Superseded the same week: orientation_mode=3 applied FlatAim dyaw to native heading and dpitch to native bank on top of the neutral native PlyrArm pose, but it caused visible spin/orbit and was replaced by a location-only default.

nodes.label: FlatAim Default Melee Preserves Native Orientation
nodes.rationale: User confirmed the Wrench stayed visible but spun/orbited on left/right aim, and native NDShockMeleeViewmodel only writes PlyrArm Location -- so orientation_mode=3 becomes location-only (writeFacing=0), with FlatAim's added Heading/Pitch/Bank writes identified as the non-native spin trigger.

nodes.label: FlatAim Melee Offsets Use Native ND.Point Local Axes
nodes.rationale: Location-only melee made the Wrench usable enough to diagnose a pure axis issue: left/right reticle motion moved the Wrench forward/back because gun-proxy local Y differs from melee local Y. The fix uses native ND.Point local axes (local X depth, Y lateral, Z vertical) instead of gun proxy axes, keeping writeFacing=0.

nodes.label: FlatAim Edge Pan Stays on Native Mouse-Look Path
nodes.rationale: Edge-pan view follow writes synthetic native mouse accumulators inside the existing PlayerTurnTilt hook and calls native PlayerTurnTilt before publishing ss2fa_aim, avoiding direct player yaw/pitch writes while keeping the FlatAim ray, projectile redirect, and proxy weapon based on the newly panned view.

nodes.label: FlatAim Pickup Reach Uses Stock 8 KEX-Unit Frob Distance
nodes.rationale: Old Shock/DeepCover source passes frobdist into PickSetFocus() as a squared max distance with fallback 64, so normal reach is sqrt(64)=8 KEX units; FlatAim's earlier 20.0 INI override of its already-correct default is reverted, with larger values kept as diagnostics only.

nodes.label: FlatAim Sidequest Is Player-Facing Freelook Mode
nodes.rationale: The mode is renamed 'Freelook mode' for players while internal artifact/protocol names (flataim.dll/ini, SS2FA, ss2fa_*) stay compatible; the public INI exposes only normal feel controls and locks weapon_proxy_scale/reach behind a hidden allow_cheat_tuning flag so gameplay-affecting values aren't presented as normal options.

nodes.label: Standalone Funk Extract Hands Must Be Static Unless Hierarchy Is Preserved
nodes.rationale: ss2vr_lj preserved source jointed metadata (motion_type=2,joint_id=2) while making the mesh subobject 0/root, and the user's test crashed AE with an AV tied to that file; standalone hand probes must use motion_type=0,joint_id=-1 unless a future exporter builds a complete static root plus jointed child hierarchy.

nodes.label: Treat LGMM Wrench Import as Reference, Not an LGMD Export Source
nodes.rationale: Raw LGMM import crumpled the arm and lacked textures, and joint offsets live in the .CAL, not the LGMD exporters, so LGMM/CAL becomes a visual reference-only workflow (BintoE.exe + Eto3DS.exe building direct Max geometry) while true LGMM+CAL export is deferred to a separate investigation doc.

nodes.label: Physical Reload Visuals Should Be Transient Objects, Not Live LGMD Subobject Reparenting
nodes.rationale: VR physical magazines/shells/cells are built as separate transient/additive visuals that follow hand pose and trigger native reload actions at validated gesture moments, rather than dynamically reparenting a magazine subobject inside the loaded LGMD weapon at runtime, keeping native reload/fire/ammo state owned by KEX.

nodes.label: Treat VR Wrench as an Authored Static LGMD Viewmodel
nodes.rationale: A new complete static LGMD (wrench plus gripping hand/forearm) driven by the existing static melee carrier/CameraObj pose path is preferred over direct LGMM export or native PlyrArm retargeting, since pipewrench_h/wrench_h are LGMM+CAL skeletal meshes but the proven FunkMax pipeline is strongest for static LGMD.

nodes.label: Use Readable ss2vr_ Aliases for Authored Weapon/Viewmodel BINs
nodes.rationale: New authored viewmodel BINs use ss2vr_<weapon_slug>.bin with exporter/provenance suffixes like _roundtrip_from_max stripped before packaging, making SS2VR-authored variants auditable and distinct from stock-name overrides used for drop-in equip compatibility.

nodes.label: Keep LGPMNM Tooling Read-Only Until the Payload Is Visually/Runtime Confirmed
nodes.rationale: The first-pass LGPMNM parser confirms coherent counts and buffers but two per-vertex extra fields remain unidentified, so writing/rewriting/runtime replacement is deferred until the high-detail mesh is visually confirmed in Max; imported LGPMNM nodes are tagged non-export so LGMD exporters ignore them.

nodes.label: Export Edited LGPMNM Wrench References as Fresh Static LGMD Snapshots
nodes.rationale: A dedicated LGPMNM -> LGMD path builds a fresh static snapshot rather than treating LGPMNM imports as patchable LGMD nodes, because the LGMD-preserving writers need original subobject/node/face identity that reference geometry lacks; lgpmnm_anchor_## helpers are treated as reference anchors, not vhots.

nodes.label: Runtime Safety Means Hierarchy Safety, Not Just Parse Safety
nodes.rationale: A user-exported BIN parsed cleanly but had a duplicated mesh and a subobject pointing its sibling field at itself, echoing a prior KEX LGMD-loader INT3 on parser-clean assets; the runtime-safety validator must now reject self-child/self-sibling links, out-of-range indices, and sibling cycles, and the LGPMNM exporter must de-duplicate mesh handles before building hierarchy.

nodes.label: Use Workflow-Oriented FunkMax Button Names
nodes.rationale: Export Exact and Funk Direct are removed from the normal rollout as implementation-history debug tools; Funk Mesh/Custom/Extract are renamed LGMD Modify Existing/Custom/Extract Subobject so button names describe user intent across the four workflow types (modify, new static, extract subobject, LGPMNM snapshot).

nodes.label: Deleted Animated Weapon Subobjects Must Be Stubbed, Not Emptied
nodes.rationale: The KEX loader can INT3 on parser-clean LGMDs that retain animated zero-face hand subobjects, so LGMD Modify Existing keeps subobject/joint identity but stubs a microscopic hidden face instead of writing true zero-face non-root subobjects. Superseded the same day after live testing showed one-face stubs and full pruning both still crashed/hung stock animated weapon overrides.

nodes.label: Stock Animated Weapon Overrides Must Keep Expected Rig Subobject Records
nodes.rationale: v1.86-pruned-weapons parsed and validated cleanly but still crashed pistol/AR/laser live, with the AR crash dump tying failure to the game-side model-loader for the pruned stock-name override; stock-name atek_h/ar15_h/lasehand overrides are not packaged unless expected rig subobjects are preserved, with stock fallback restored until a new strategy proves safe.

nodes.label: Keep CURRENT_STATE as a Dashboard, Not an Archive
nodes.rationale: CURRENT_STATE.md had become a mixed dashboard/changelog/test-queue/archive that made reloads expensive and hid the current priority; detailed build archaeology moves to BUILD_HISTORY.md and inactive notes to CURRENT_STATE_ARCHIVE.md so future agents don't inherit stale experiments as active work.

nodes.label: Lock Accepted v1.90 ATEK Pistol by Exact Digest
nodes.rationale: User confirmed v1.89's full-rig pistol was loader-safe but still showed the left hand, and v1.90's repaired one-face structure removes it; the runtime-safety validator allowlists only this exact atek_h.bin SHA256 for near-empty hand subobjects, explicitly not extending safety to AR or laser pistol one-face variants.

nodes.label: Reserve High Vhot IDs for SS2VR Weapon Metadata
nodes.rationale: Native AE vhots 0..3 stay reserved for muzzle/eject behavior while vhot_80/81/82 carry SS2VR VR-pivot/support/reload metadata without a new sidecar format. Superseded 2026-06-19 by the low-contiguous-ID rule after a high-ID AR15 candidate crashed KEX's native LGMD loader before menu.

nodes.label: Add Nemyax-Parity Full-Prune Exporter as a Diagnostic Path
nodes.rationale: The original full-prune failure may have been confounded by a leaf-only node rebuild rather than subobject removal itself, so a separate LGMD Nemyax Prune TEST path fully removes emptied subobjects while rebuilding surviving hierarchy nodes in the Nemyax Blender exporter's compiler-shaped child/call/split style; runtime status remains unproven pending one-weapon-at-a-time testing.

nodes.label: Add Static LGMD Mirror Workflow for Empty Right-Hand Candidates
nodes.rationale: A prior Max-side negative-scale/Reset-XForm mirror left viewport normals/facing ambiguous because game-side correctness depends on face winding, light refs, UV refs, and packed light normals staying coherent together; LGMD Mirror Static transforms all of those fields in one binary operation and repairs stale header count bytes at the same time.

nodes.label: Add Append-Static Path for Stock Animated Weapon Hand Meshes
nodes.rationale: LGMD Custom rebuilt shotgun internals in a crashy shape by changing the animated pump vertex range, so LGMD Append Static adds the hand as a new static child subobject with its own contiguous vertex/light/normal ranges, preserving the stock animated rig's original ranges untouched.
